title: EventBus cross-owner broadcast after selective unregister contract

contract.selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the listener registration owned by the specified plugin
contract.remaining_owner_preservation: Other owners registered for the same event remain active
contract.cross_owner_broadcast: An event emitted by a plugin is delivered to remaining listeners regardless of their owner
contract.removed_owner_isolation: A selectively unregistered listener receives no subsequent events
contract.source_metadata: The emitted event preserves the emitting plugin_id as event source metadata
contract.registry_preservation: Broadcast delivery after selective unregister does not modify the remaining listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
